title: A DESCENDANT IS NOT THE ANCESTOR
semantic_thesis: A translation, summary, rendering or crop can remain faithfully descended from a source without becoming identical to that source. Lineage may survive transformation while identity and authority change.

ru: Потомок может честно нести происхождение предка, не притворяясь самим предком.
Перевод может быть верным и всё равно требовать собственной проверки.
Изменение формы не обязано уничтожать lineage, но lineage не отменяет различие форм.
en: A descendant may faithfully carry an ancestor's lineage without pretending to be the ancestor.
A translation may be faithful and still require its own verification.
Changing form need not destroy lineage, but lineage does not erase the difference between forms.

boundary: Semantic interpretation only; no universal semantic-equivalence claim.
